newsitem.title: USA: Stone & Webster sees 1997 operating net up.
newsitem.headline: Stone & Webster sees 1997 operating net up.

text.p: Stone & Webster Inc said on Tuesday that it expects a 15 percent improvement in operating earnings performance in 1997 from the elimination of unprofitable operations, enhanced organization and management, and a solid backlog of work.
The global engineering, construction and consulting company said it implemented a strategy to continue to build upon strong market share positions.
Stone & Wester previously announced it plans to sell substantial real estate assets and reinvest the proceeds in the company's growing core business.
Earlier, the company reported earnings for 1996 -- before a number of restructuring and other charges -- of $2.04 per share from ongoing operations, up 15 percent from $1.78 a year before.
